presentation.label: SAMPLE LAYER
presentation.summary: Sample engines for the SMPL key: FUNC + SMPL picks SAMPLER (stock) or TRANSIENT for each sound, which shapes the sample alone apart from the analog voice.
presentation.overview: Sample Layer gives a track's sample an engine, chosen per sound from a list like SRC's machine list (FUNC + SMPL). SAMPLER is stock's playback. TRANSIENT shapes the sample before its DAC: a punch or a soft attack, a decay of its own, a band the sample passes through, and a shift of up to 30 ms after the analog voice. The analog machine, filter and AMP envelope are left as they are, and the engine and its settings are saved with the sound.
highlights: FUNC + SMPL: an engine list in the style of SRC's machine list.
PCH: a snap with a pitch blip, or a soft attack rising in pitch.
DEC: a decay for the sample alone, 4 ms to 3 s.
BAS and WID: a band, drawn as one curve over E and F.
SHF: the sample lands up to 30 ms after the analog hit.
usage: Put a sample on a BD track with an analog machine. Hold FUNC and press SMPL, pick TRANSIENT and press YES.
Turn PCH to the right while a pattern plays: the sample gets a sharper click on top of the analog body. Turn it to the left: the sample swells in softly.
Turn DEC down: the sample is only the attack of the hit while the analog part rings on.
Raise BAS and lower WID: the sample thins to a narrow band. Turn SHF up: the sample lands a little after the analog hit.
Pick SAMPLER in the list: the sound plays as stock's again.

access.location: FUNC + SMPL on any track with a sample: the engine list. TRANSIENT's page on SMPL.
steps: Select a track with a sample, hold FUNC and press SMPL.

controls.name: PCH
controls.doc: Punch, -64 to +62: right of 0 a snap with a pitch blip of up to +2 semitones, left a fade-in of up to 40 ms rising from up to 4 semitones low.

controls.name: DEC
controls.doc: The sample's own decay from each trig, 4 ms to 3 s; the top is INF, no decay.

controls.name: BAS
controls.doc: The band's base, 20 Hz to 18 kHz: a high-pass on the sample.

controls.name: WID
controls.doc: How far the band reaches above BAS: a low-pass on what is left. 127 leaves the top open.

controls.name: SHF
controls.doc: Delays the sample 0 to 30 ms after the analog voice, taken at each trig.

limitations: Built for OS 1.74 on Modwerk's base only (it follows the base's AMP record for the trigs).
The settings cannot be p-locked or reached over MIDI: they live outside the sound's parameters.
40 of the sound's 56 storage bits: a set whose sound fields need more will not link (Voice DAC takes 39, LFO RND 16).
A change reaches a playing voice within about 50 ms.

load.conditions: Measure with every track playing, parameters modulated and the mod at its heaviest setting.

hardware.summary: 0.1.0-experimental on chevyone's Analog Rytm MKII, OS 1.74, RAM-booted over the development link (SL03 to SL20 on the plain development base 6844766f; SL20 is this source). The author played TRANSIENT by ear and reported every control working, kit save and power cycle included; the list and the page were captured over the link.
limitations: Ran from RAM on a development base with a USB test link, not the published base.
Not run: the audio load with TRANSIENT on every voice, beside other Rytm modules in one image, rytm-emu.

tests.summary: Host: the render bit for bit as stock when neutral, SHF's delays, PUNCH's pitch on a 1 kHz tone. Unit (author's MKII, RAM boot, SL03 to SL20): the list, TRANSIENT's page and every control, reported working by the author; captures over the link. Load and other modules beside it not measured.
